main_measure.name: mean excess 10-bar forward return after new-high bars (minus coin's mean 10-bar return), non-overlapping, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 non-overlapping events

supporting_check.name: mean excess 10-bar return of events whose next close is below the new high

decided_by: Mean excess 10-bar return 0.0214 > 0 with t = 2.23 >= 2 over 384 non-overlapping events.
reading: A new-high bar is a bar whose recorded countdown equals 20 and that has a 10-bar forward return inside its window; within each window, events are taken in time order and one less than 10 bars after the last counted event is skipped; the coin's mean is over every bar with a 10-bar return in all its windows; the new high is that bar's close; the supporting check is reported only and does not change the status.
